unit: luma 0-255 (mean of a background region x1150-1530 y620-820)
sampling: captured pictures only (24/30 fps cadence on the 60 fps grid)
note: second half of the white flash: the incoming 3D card close-up fades down from white and racks into focus at the same time (frame median luma 224 -> 78, brand-mark sharpness 1.1 -> 24, both settled by f4025); measured on a background patch that holds still after the flash; the card keeps a slow orbit drift (about -0.13% W per frame)
